name: tiny_physical
description: Tiny config, amplitudeMode 'physical' (radar equation; noise k*T0*F*fs, variance 1); per-scatterer amplitudes in 'amplitudes'

tolerances.toleranceNotes: truth*Abs = interpolation bias (0.03 bin, 0.05 deg) + largest deterministic offset in this case (range-Doppler coupling, carrier scaling, cos(phi) projection of the 1-D azimuth FFT). angleDeg is compared with truth.angleDeg only when the velocity is not aliased.
